Farms & Land for Sale

List or find farms, plots and ranches for local and international buyers.

Buying from abroad? Rules on land ownership by non-citizens apply in Zambia. Before paying anything: check the title at the Ministry of Lands, use a registered lawyer, visit the plot or send a trusted agent, and pay only through traceable channels. This site only connects people and is not legal advice.

Farm Help Centre

Problem solver: symptoms & what to do

General guidance only. For suspected notifiable diseases (FMD, anthrax, ASF, Newcastle) tell your local veterinary office immediately, and ask your extension officer before using any chemical. Seen it on your farm? Report the outbreak so neighbours can protect their animals and crops.

About FarmConnect Zambia

A free, simple website that helps farmers grow better, sell further and own land safely.

FarmConnect Zambia brings farming advice, rain and disease alerts, a village market, farm and land listings and a transport board together in one place that works on a basic phone and on slow data.

What we do

Weather & Alerts

Seasonal advice by location, rain reports from farmers and disease alerts nearby.

Village Market

Free listings for crops, vegetables, livestock, eggs and honey.

Farms & Land

Farms, plots and ranches for local and international buyers.

Transport

Offer or find transport to take produce to market.

Farm Help

Tips on crops, animals, soil, climate and selling, plus a disease problem solver.

Our promise

Free and simpleNo sign-up and no fees to post. Built for small phones and slow connections.
Local firstMenus and headings also in Chinyanja, Chibemba, Chitonga and Silozi.
Honest and safeWe only connect people. We are not a lawyer, a vet or a weather service.
Please remember: check land titles at the Ministry of Lands and use a registered lawyer before paying. Rain onset on this site is a seasonal estimate, not a live forecast. For suspected notifiable animal diseases, tell your local veterinary office immediately.

Send us a message

Questions, ideas or something wrong on the site? Leave your name and a phone number or email so we can reply.
